20002.long_desc: The Touch Wizard offers players flexibility of playing games via touchscreen and joystick game play. Supports almost all consoles, gaming options are endless. Also comes with side buttons for pinball game play. Players can also enjoy all the benefits of Google's Play store by downloading their favourite Android games, social media and music apps. This means that not only are their favourite games available on a cabinet style machine, but they can also be played with the Sanwa joysticks and buttons. This machine compatible with a variety of hardware and software add-ons, it is Arcooda's short base, bar top arcade machine. Game Wizard machines are user-friendly with a purpose-built Arcooda Plug and Play system. This unique board allows the user to simply plug in consoles, PC, android or arcade game boards for instant access to an unlimited range of games. MONITOR: 19" Full Multi Touchscreen, The High Definition 1080P (1080 x 1920) with VGA + HDMI HD LCD Monitor is perfect for playing your favourite mobile games on a bigger screen. CONTROLS: The Touch Wizard arcade machine features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world's premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble free operation. It also features additional Sanwa buttons located at the sides of the control panel to simulate the feel of playing video pinball but in a compact scale. CABINET: The Touch Wizard features Up to 2mm powdercoated steel construction, with backlit acrylic panels header. It also has a 2mm powder coated steel control panel, Android motherboard with 64G storage and +5V 20A +12V 8A Power Supply. SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. WIRING: The cabinet is designed with Jamma wiring system. The machine also supports JVS wiring system (optional) and Game Wizard (optional). GAME WIZARD READY: Supports virtually all late model consoles, just plug in your XBOX One or PlayStation 4 and start playing the current games such as Street Fghter 6 with ease. Just like being in an arcade centre. PLAY YOUR WAY: Supports almost all console controllers, play with Arcade Joystick, touchscreen or hand console controller (subject to game software support). The gaming choice is yours. UNLIMITED GAMING: Connect your Steam, XBOX Live, Playstation Plus, Origin, Google Play store, etc… accounts and have an “all-in-one” cabinet. Never get tired of the same games. EASILY SERVICABLE: All internal designs are plug and play, no need any technician or special tools as all components are designed with plugs, and cabinet is either opened with key or latches so no need to dismantle the machine to gain access. NEVER OBSOLETE:Regular firmware updates to ensure future console compatibility and continuous improvement to software. When new consoles are released, upgrade (free) your Touch Wizard machine to the latest console with firmware update. The Game Wizard Xtreme uses the HIGHWAY IO board, a custom designed IO board supporting the widest range of gaming options. Upon receiving an Arcooda machine you can register it online to join the owner's community for benefits such as set up videos, firmware updates, special downloads, exclusive discounts, technical support and the owners forum. Disclaimer: All product and company names are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective holders. Use of them does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them. On Screen Images are for demonstration purposes only. GameBoard is not included with the purchase of this machine
